question: Which Yadav JCI188734 source panels and GSE242510 libraries support a bounded descriptive reconstruction, and which biological-unit or assay prerequisites remain unknown?
decision: Qualify source identity and per-job eligibility for review before any functional effect or coculture RNA contrast is executed.
strongest_rival: Treating slices, wells, cell barcodes, library suffixes or accession IDs as independent animals, preparations or donors would create pseudoreplication or false pairing.
discriminator: Join GEO, BioSample and sequencing accessions; inspect workbook labels and source panel legends; validate count-file structure without treating missing identifiers as evidence of independence.
exposure_record: Published outcomes, supplied final article, supplement and workbook values were viewed before this metadata contract. Library labels and linked BioSample/experiment records were inspected. No local biological effect or RNA contrast has run. Freezing does not erase this exposure.
biological_unit: Animals for whole-lung panels; human donor pairs or patients for human assays; coculture preparation identity and pooling remain unknown for GSE242510.
nesting_and_overlap: Slices and wells nest in source patients or donor combinations; cells nest in libraries. Numeric library suffixes do not prove preparation pairing. Source panels and deposited data are reused published evidence, not independent replication.
population_and_selection: The official JCI188734 supporting-values workbook and six GSE242510 libraries, with linked public BioSample and sequencing records. Source-selected published panels; no new cohort.
contrast: Metadata and source eligibility only: functional panels 3B/D/E/J/K, 5A/D-F, S3C-D; WT versus P2rx4-KO fibroblast coculture and fibroblast monoculture library inventories; optional spatial source availability.
endpoint: Source-file hashes, workbook sheet/cell labels and numeric occupancy, library/accession joins, matrix header dimensions and identifier uniqueness. No biological effect endpoint estimated.
methods: Standard-library OOXML parsing retains all source values and cell coordinates, labels, style IDs, merges and formula presence. Parse SOFT/XML joins; inventory compressed archive members without extraction; compare matrix header dimensions to unique feature/barcode rows. Manual primary-source qualification is recorded separately.
missingness_and_exclusions: Keep blank source cells blank, zeros zero and unnamed specimen/pooling/pairing fields unknown. Include all workbook sheets and six libraries. Do not infer donor assignment from row order. Stop on source-join or matrix-identifier mismatch.
multiplicity: Not applicable: no hypothesis tests or biological effect estimates in this metadata run.
precision_basis: Metadata inventory has no population precision claim. Unknown or sparse biological units constrain future effect analyses.
interpretation_limit: File-format and accession agreement do not establish biological independence, patient pairing, valid cell annotation or scientific acceptance. Metabolite abundance is not flux; source reconstruction is not replication.
stop_rule: Stop after inventory and source qualification. Dependent effect analyses await the review checkpoint and separate prospective contracts. Missing biological units or spatial inputs remain explicit holds.
amendment_reason: Initial exposed metadata execution contract; no effect estimation and no scientific acceptance.
